description: MHA* (Multi-Heuristic A*) uses several heuristics at once and still bounds the solution cost. One *anchor* heuristic must be consistent; the others may be *inadmissible* (they can overestimate) and only guide the search. Each heuristic has its own queue, ordered by `g + w₁ · h`. In round robin, an inadmissible queue may expand while its best key is at most `w₂` times the anchor's best key; otherwise the anchor expands. The shared variant (SMHA*) shares path costs between queues and expands each state at most twice, and the result costs at most `w₁ · w₂` times the optimum.

papers.authors: Sandip Aine, Siddharth Swaminathan, Venkatraman Narayanan, Victor Hwang, Maxim Likhachev
papers.title: Multi-Heuristic A*
papers.venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research
